integrity: The all-order lower bound uses a potential valid on all binary de Bruijn edges, including forbidden additional windows. The upper bound uses an explicit balanced augmentation and Eulerian connectivity. Finite checks and example witnesses are embedded with their sources. Historical priority and independent scientific verification have not been certified.
scientific_limitations: All-order theorem is limited to binary length-n factors avoiding both 000 and 111, and to one circular cover that may repeat factors. No classification of all optima, other maximum-run constraints, or linear-cover optimum is claimed. The finite computational tests support but do not replace the all-order proof; unindexed prior literature remains a priority risk.
title: A Lucas-number formula for shortest circular covers of binary words with runs at most two
